reason: Base200 frozen characterization eval (demo_randomized / confirm_hard) can raise
envs.utils.create_actor.UnStableError during setup_demo for a frozen held-out seed.
That event is operational simulator missingness, not learned-policy failure, and must
not crash the shard, replace the seed, or be counted as success=false in the primary SR.
This amendment freezes the recording and denominator rule for Base200 eval resumes.

do not infinite-retry the same UnStableError, do not swap seeds, and do not treat it
